+def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
+    seq = db.query(IdSequence).filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year).with_for_update().one_or_none()
+    if seq is None:
+        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
+        db.add(seq); db.flush()
+    seq.last_value += 1
+    db.flush()
+    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"
+```

+"""Live API demo — hits the running uvicorn server."""
+import json
+import sys
+import urllib.request
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.error
+
+BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8003"
+
+
+def req(method, path, body=None, token=None, timeout=30):
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    if token:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
+    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}{path}", data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=timeout) as resp:
+            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode() or "null")
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or "null")
+
+
+def hr(c):
+    return "\n" + "─" * 60 + f"\n  {c}\n" + "─" * 60
+
+

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import create as create_user
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id, list_users
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import soft_delete as soft_delete_user
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import update as update_user
from src.backend.models.user import User
from src.backend.schemas.user import UserCreate, UserUpdate


def list_users_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int, int, int]:
    items, total = list_users(db, page, page_size, q, role, is_active)
    return items, total, page, page_size


def create_user_service(db: Session, data: UserCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> User:
    password_hash = hash_password(data.password)
    employee_business_id = next_business_id(db, "EMP")
    user = create_user(db, data.email, data.name, password_hash, data.role.value, employee_business_id)

    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id
    update_user(db, user)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.create",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "id": str(user.id),
            "email": user.email,
            "name": user.name,
            "role": user.role,
            "employee_business_id": user.employee_business_id,
        },
    )

    return user


def get_user_service(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return get_by_id(db, user_id)


def update_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: UserUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
    is_self: bool = False,
) -> User | None:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return None

    before_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    if data.name is not None:
        user.name = data.name
    if data.role is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.role = data.role.value
    if data.is_active is not None:
        if is_self:
            return None
        user.is_active = data.is_active
    if data.employee_role_code is not None:
        user.employee_role_code = data.employee_role_code.value
    if data.department is not None:
        user.department = data.department
    if data.date_of_joining is not None:
        user.date_of_joining = data.date_of_joining
    if data.date_of_exit is not None:
        user.date_of_exit = data.date_of_exit
    if data.employment_status is not None:
        user.employment_status = data.employment_status.value
    if data.location is not None:
        user.location = data.location
    if data.reporting_manager_id is not None:
        user.reporting_manager_id = data.reporting_manager_id

    update_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "name": user.name,
        "role": user.role,
        "is_active": user.is_active,
        "employee_role_code": user.employee_role_code,
        "department": user.department,
        "employment_status": user.employment_status,
        "location": user.location,
        "reporting_manager_id": str(user.reporting_manager_id) if user.reporting_manager_id else None,
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.update",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return user


def soft_delete_user_service(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user:
        return False

    before_json = {
        "deleted_at": None,
    }

    soft_delete_user(db, user)

    after_json = {
        "deleted_at": str(user.deleted_at),
    }

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="user.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return True

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo, audit_repo, inquiry_repo
from src.backend.models.inquiry import Inquiry
from src.backend.models.service_agreement import (
    AgreementStatus,
    BillingModel,
    ServiceAgreement,
)
from src.backend.schemas.service_agreement import (
    ServiceAgreementCreate,
    ServiceAgreementUpdate,
)


def list_agreements_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id, status=status
    )
    return items, total, page, page_size


def list_agreements_by_client_service(
    db: Session,
    client_id: uuid.UUID,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id
    )
    return items, total, page, page_size


def get_agreement_service(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
    return agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)


def create_agreement_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ServiceAgreementCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> ServiceAgreement:
    inquiry: Inquiry | None = None
    if data.inquiry_id is not None:
        inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, data.inquiry_id)
        if not inquiry:
            raise LookupError(f"inquiry {data.inquiry_id} not found")

    business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
    agreement = agreement_repo.create_agreement(
        db,
        agreement_id=business_id,
        client_id=data.client_id,
        inquiry_id=data.inquiry_id,
        service_name=data.service_name,
        start_date=data.start_date,
        end_date=data.end_date,
        total_tokens=data.total_tokens,
        billing_model=data.billing_model.value,
        status=data.status.value,
        notes=data.notes,
    )

    if inquiry is not None:
        if inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id is None:
            inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id = agreement.id

    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="agreement.create",
        entity_type="service_agreement",
        entity_id=agreement.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "agreement_id": agreement.agreement_id,
            "client_id": str(agreement.client_id),
            "inquiry_id": str(agreement.inquiry_id) if agreement.inquiry_id else None,
            "service_name": agreement.service_name,
        },
    )
    agreement_repo.commit_agreement(db, agreement)
    return agreement


def update_agreement_service(
    db: Session,
    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: ServiceAgreementUpdate,

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories import audit_repo, inquiry_repo
from src.backend.models.inquiry import Inquiry, InquiryPriority, InquiryStatus, InquiryType
from src.backend.models.service_agreement import BillingModel, ServiceAgreement
from src.backend.schemas.inquiry import InquiryCreate, InquiryUpdate


class InquiryAlreadyConvertedError(Exception):
    """Raised when caller attempts to re-convert an inquiry."""


def list_inquiries_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Inquiry], int, int, int]:
    items, total = inquiry_repo.list_inquiries(db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q, status=status)
    return items, total, page, page_size


def get_inquiry_service(db: Session, inquiry_id: uuid.UUID) -> Inquiry | None:
    return inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)


def create_inquiry_service(
    db: Session,
    data: InquiryCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Inquiry:
    business_id = next_business_id(db, "INQ", date.today().year)
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.create_inquiry(
        db,
        inquiry_id=business_id,
        inquiry_date=data.inquiry_date,
        inquiry_type=data.inquiry_type.value,
        inquiry_source=data.inquiry_source,
        client_name=data.client_name,
        requirement_summary=data.requirement_summary,
        estimated_value=data.estimated_value,
        priority=data.priority.value,
        status=data.status.value,
        owner=data.owner,
        technical_lead=data.technical_lead,
        notes=data.notes,
    )
    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.create",
        entity_type="inquiry",
        entity_id=inquiry.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "inquiry_id": inquiry.inquiry_id,
            "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
            "status": inquiry.status,
        },
    )
    inquiry_repo.commit_inquiry(db, inquiry)
    return inquiry


def update_inquiry_service(
    db: Session,
    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: InquiryUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Inquiry | None:
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
    if not inquiry:
        return None

    before = {
        "status": inquiry.status,
        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
        "priority": inquiry.priority,
    }

    if data.inquiry_date is not None:
        inquiry.inquiry_date = data.inquiry_date
    if data.inquiry_type is not None:
        inquiry.inquiry_type = data.inquiry_type.value
    if data.inquiry_source is not None:
        inquiry.inquiry_source = data.inquiry_source
    if data.client_name is not None:
        inquiry.client_name = data.client_name
    if data.requirement_summary is not None:
        inquiry.requirement_summary = data.requirement_summary
    if data.estimated_value is not None:
        inquiry.estimated_value = data.estimated_value
    if data.priority is not None:
        inquiry.priority = data.priority.value
    if data.status is not None:
        inquiry.status = data.status.value
    if data.owner is not None:
        inquiry.owner = data.owner
    if data.technical_lead is not None:
        inquiry.technical_lead = data.technical_lead
    if data.notes is not None:
        inquiry.notes = data.notes

    after = {
        "status": inquiry.status,
        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
        "priority": inquiry.priority,
    }
    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.update",
        entity_type="inquiry",
        entity_id=inquiry.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json=before,
        after_json=after,
    )
    inquiry_repo.commit_inquiry(db, inquiry)
    return inquiry


def delete_inquiry_service(
    db: Session,
    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> bool:
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
    if not inquiry:
        return False

    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.delete",
        entity_type="inquiry",
        entity_id=inquiry.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"inquiry_id": inquiry.inquiry_id, "client_name": inquiry.client_name},
    )
    inquiry_repo.delete_inquiry(db, inquiry)
    return True


VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES = {s.value for s in InquiryStatus}


def transition_inquiry_service(
    db: Session,
    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
    new_status: InquiryStatus,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    *,
    client_code: str | None = None,
    client_primary_email: str | None = None,
    service_name: str | None = None,
    start_date: date | None = None,
) -> tuple[Inquiry, "ServiceAgreement | None"]:
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
    if not inquiry:
        raise LookupError("inquiry not found")

    if new_status.value not in VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid status: {new_status}")

    before_status = inquiry.status

    if new_status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED:
        if inquiry.status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED.value:
            raise InquiryAlreadyConvertedError("inquiry already converted")
        missing: list[str] = []
        if not client_code:
            missing.append("client_code")
        if not client_primary_email:
            missing.append("client_primary_email")
        if not service_name:
            missing.append("service_name")
        if start_date is None:
            missing.append("start_date")
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"missing required fields for Converted: {', '.join(missing)}")

        assert client_code and client_primary_email and service_name and start_date is not None

        from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo

        business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
        client, agreement = inquiry_repo.convert_inquiry(
            db,
            inquiry,
            client_code=client_code,
            client_primary_email=client_primary_email,
            service_name=service_name,
            start_date=start_date,
        )
        agreement.agreement_id = business_id
        agreement.client_id = client.id
        db.flush()

        audit_repo.create_entry(
            db,
            action="inquiry.convert",
            entity_type="inquiry",
            entity_id=inquiry.id,
            user_id=actor_id,
            before_json={"status": before_status},
            after_json={
                "status": inquiry.status,
                "client_id": str(client.id),
                "agreement_id": str(agreement.id),
            },
        )
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(inquiry)
        db.refresh(agreement)
        return inquiry, agreement

    inquiry.status = new_status.value
    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.status_transition",
        entity_type="inquiry",
        entity_id=inquiry.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"status": before_status},
        after_json={"status": inquiry.status},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inquiry)
    return inquiry, None

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.user import User


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.email == email, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id, User.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    role: str | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    query = db.query(User).filter(User.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(User.email.ilike(search) | User.name.ilike(search))

    if role:
        query = query.filter(User.role == role)

    if is_active is not None:
        query = query.filter(User.is_active == is_active)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(User.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def create(
    db: Session,
    email: str,
    name: str,
    password_hash: str,
    role: str,
    employee_business_id: str | None = None,
) -> User:
    user = User(
        email=email,
        name=name,
        password_hash=password_hash,
        role=role,
        employee_business_id=employee_business_id,
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def update(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def soft_delete(db: Session, user: User) -> User:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    user.deleted_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user

display.text:
"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

"""Wave 9 / Agent Zeta — Employee patch tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def test_employee_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "test-employee@example.com",
            "name": "Test Employee",
            "password": "TestPassword123!",
            "role": "ADMIN",
            "employee_role_code": "AE",
            "department": "DESIGN",
            "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
            "employment_status": "Active",
            "location": "AHMEDABAD",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["employee_business_id"] is not None
    assert body["employee_business_id"].startswith("SWA-")
    assert body["employee_business_id"].endswith("-EMP-001")


async def test_employee_business_id_increments(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    year = date.today().year
    ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        r = await authed_admin_client.post(
            "/api/users",
            json={
                "email": f"test-employee-{i}@example.com",
                "name": f"Test Employee {i}",
                "password": "TestPassword123!",
                "role": "ADMIN",
                "employee_role_code": "AE",
                "department": "DESIGN",
                "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
                "employment_status": "Active",
                "location": "AHMEDABAD",
            },
        )
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["employee_business_id"])

    assert ids == [
        f"SWA-{year}-EMP-001",
        f"SWA-{year}-EMP-002",
        f"SWA-{year}-EMP-003",
    ]


async def test_employee_role_code_enum(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "test-ae@example.com",
            "name": "Test AE",
            "password": "TestPassword123!",
            "role": "ADMIN",
            "employee_role_code": "AE",
            "department": "DESIGN",
            "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
            "employment_status": "Active",
            "location": "AHMEDABAD",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["employee_role_code"] == "AE"


async def test_employment_status_default(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "test-default@example.com",
            "name": "Test Default",
            "password": "TestPassword123!",
            "role": "ADMIN",
            "employee_role_code": "AE",
            "department": "DESIGN",
            "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["employment_status"] == "Active"


async def test_user_with_reporting_manager(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "test-manager@example.com",
            "name": "Test Manager",
            "password": "TestPassword123!",
            "role": "ADMIN",
            "employee_role_code": "AE",
            "department": "DESIGN",
            "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
            "employment_status": "Active",
            "location": "AHMEDABAD",
            "reporting_manager_id": str(admin_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["reporting_manager_id"] == str(admin_user.id)


async def test_employee_fields_in_read(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "test-read@example.com",
            "name": "Test Read",
            "password": "TestPassword123!",
            "role": "ADMIN",
            "employee_role_code": "SE",
            "department": "MARKETING",
            "date_of_joining": "2024-01-01",
            "date_of_exit": "2025-01-01",
            "employment_status": "Exited",
            "location": "MUMBAI",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    user_id = r.json()["id"]

    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/users/{user_id}")

    body = r.json()

    assert body["department"] == "MARKETING"
    assert body["date_of_joining"] == "2024-01-01"
    assert body["date_of_exit"] == "2025-01-01"
    assert body["employment_status"] == "Exited"
    assert body["location"] == "MUMBAI"
    assert body["employee_business_id"] is not None

"""Wave 9 / Agent Alpha — Agreement API tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def _create_client(authed_admin_client, code: str = "TEST-CLIENT-001") -> str:
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/clients",
        json={"name": "Test Client", "code": code, "primary_email": f"{code.lower()}@example.com"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client, **kwargs) -> str:
    data = {
        "inquiry_date": "2025-01-15",
        "inquiry_type": "Design",
        "client_name": "Test Client",
        "estimated_value": "10000.00",
    }
    data.update(kwargs)

    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/inquiries", json=data)
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def _create_agreement(authed_admin_client, client_id: str | None = None, **kwargs) -> str:
    if client_id is None:
        client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client)

    data = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "service_name": "TEST-SERVICE",
        "start_date": "2025-02-01",
        "billing_model": "Fixed",
    }
    data.update(kwargs)

    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/agreements", json=data)
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def test_create_agreement(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client)
    agreement_id = await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client, client_id=client_id)
    assert agreement_id is not None


async def test_list_agreements(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    # Create first agreement
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    # Create second agreement
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    # List agreements
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/agreements")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["total"] >= 2
    assert len(body["items"]) >= 2


async def test_get_agreement(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    agreement_id = await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/agreements/{agreement_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == agreement_id
    assert body["service_name"] == "TEST-SERVICE"


async def test_update_agreement(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    agreement_id = await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    r = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/agreements/{agreement_id}",
        json={"service_name": "Updated Service", "status": "Completed"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["service_name"] == "Updated Service"
    assert body["status"] == "Completed"


async def test_delete_agreement(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    agreement_id = await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    r = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/agreements/{agreement_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 204

    # Verify deleted
    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/agreements/{agreement_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 404


async def test_list_agreements_by_client(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client)

    # Create agreements for this client
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client, client_id=client_id)
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client, client_id=client_id)

    # Create agreement for another client
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    # List agreements by client
    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/agreements/by-client/{client_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["total"] >= 2
    assert len(body["items"]) >= 2
    assert all(item["client_id"] == client_id for item in body["items"])


async def test_agreement_with_inquiry(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    # Create inquiry first
    inquiry_id = await _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client)

    # Create agreement linked to inquiry
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client)
    agreement_id = await _create_agreement(
        authed_admin_client,
        client_id=client_id,
        inquiry_id=inquiry_id,
    )

    # Verify agreement has inquiry_id
    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/agreements/{agreement_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    agreement = r.json()
    assert agreement["inquiry_id"] == inquiry_id

    # Verify inquiry has converted_to_agreement_id
    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    inquiry = r.json()
    assert inquiry["converted_to_agreement_id"] == agreement_id


async def test_agreement_id_generation(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    # Create multiple agreements and verify they have IDs
    agreement_ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        agreement_id = await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)
        agreement_ids.append(agreement_id)

    assert len(agreement_ids) == 3
    assert all(id is not None for id in agreement_ids)


async def test_agreement_status_filter(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    # Create active agreement
    await _create_agreement(authed_admin_client)

    # List with status filter
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/agreements?status=Active")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body["items"]) >= 1

    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == inquiry_id
    assert body["client_name"] == "Test Client"


async def test_update_inquiry(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    inquiry_id = await _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client)

    r = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}",
        json={"client_name": "Updated Client", "priority": "High"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["client_name"] == "Updated Client"
    assert body["priority"] == "High"


async def test_delete_inquiry(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    inquiry_id = await _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client)

    r = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 204

    # Verify deleted

async def test_inquiry_status_transition(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    inquiry_id = await _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client)

    # Transition to Contacted
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/transition",
        json={"status": "Contacted"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["status"] == "Contacted"

    # Transition to Qualified
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/transition",
        json={"status": "Qualified"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["status"] == "Qualified"


async def test_convert_inquiry_to_client_and_agreement(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    inquiry_id = await _create_inquiry(authed_admin_client)

    # Convert inquiry to Client + ServiceAgreement
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/transition",
        json={
            "status": "Converted",
            "client_code": "CONV-CLIENT-001",
            "client_primary_email": "conv@example.com",
            "service_name": "INSUDESIGN",
            "start_date": "2025-02-01",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["status"] == "Converted"
    assert body["converted_to_client_id"] is not None

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class EmployeeRoleCode(StrEnum):
    AE = "AE"
    SE = "SE"
    RE = "RE"
    PM = "PM"
    AUD = "AUD"
    HR = "HR"
    MKT = "MKT"
    FOUNDER = "FOUNDER"


class EmploymentStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "Active"
    EXITED = "Exited"
    ON_LEAVE = "On Leave"


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)

    employee_business_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        String(64), nullable=True, unique=True, index=True
    )
    employee_role_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16), nullable=True, index=True)
    department: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True, index=True)
    date_of_joining: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    date_of_exit: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    employment_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20),
        nullable=False,
        default=EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE.value,
        server_default=EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE.value,
    )
    location: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=True)
    reporting_manager_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )

    reporting_manager: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        "User",
        remote_side=lambda: [User.id],
        foreign_keys=lambda: [User.reporting_manager_id],
    )

Now I see. Each test function creates its own `db_session` with `_reset_tables()` which drops and recreates all tables. So each test starts with a clean DB.

The test `test_employee_business_id_increments` creates 3 users in a loop. Each call to `POST /api/users` goes through the service and repo. The `_reset_tables()` is called at the start of each test, creating fresh tables.

The server-side code will:
1. Call `next_business_id(db, "EMP")` - this queries `IdSequence` table, gets the current counter for EMP, and increments it.
2. Create the user with `employee_business_id = "SWA-2026-EMP-001"`.

If all three requests use the same `db_session` (which they do, since `client_with_db` overrides `get_db` with a single `db_session`), then the sequence should work correctly.

But wait - there's a `db.commit()` in `create_user` repo function. And after that, `next_business_id` uses `db.flush()` to save the sequence counter. So subsequent calls should see the incremented counter.

Hmm, but the 422 error means the request is failing before it even gets to the service layer. It's a Pydantic validation error. Let me think about what could cause a 422 for these requests...

Actually, maybe the issue is that the `_reset_tables()` function, combined with the `setup_test_db` session fixture, causes issues with concurrent table creation. But no, the 422 is about request validation, not database.

Wait, I need to re-look at the failing tests. Let me check if maybe the issue is that on the 2nd call in the loop, there's a race condition with the `IdSequence` table. If `create_user` does `db.commit()` and the sequence is only flushed (not committed), then the sequence lock might be lost.

Actually, I bet the issue is simpler. Looking at the current `user_service.py` `create_user_service`:

```python
employee_business_id = next_business_id(db, "EMP")
```

This calls `next_business_id(db, "EMP")` without a year, so it defaults to `current_year()`. But in `next_business_id`, when `year is None`, it does `year = current_year()`. Then it queries `IdSequence` and does `db.flush()` to save. But then `create_user` does `db.commit()` (line 59 of user_repo.py).

Looking at `next_business_id`:
```python
def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()
    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()
    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()
    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"
```

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.service_agreement import ServiceAgreement


def list_agreements(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int]:
    query = db.query(ServiceAgreement)

    if client_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.client_id == client_id)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(ServiceAgreement.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return list(items), total


def get_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
    return db.query(ServiceAgreement).filter(ServiceAgreement.id == agreement_id).first()


def get_agreement_by_business_id(db: Session, agreement_business_id: str) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
    return (
        db.query(ServiceAgreement)
        .filter(ServiceAgreement.agreement_id == agreement_business_id)
        .first()
    )


def create_agreement(
    db: Session,
    *,
    agreement_id: str,
    client_id: uuid.UUID,
    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    service_name: str,
    start_date: date,
    end_date: date | None,
    total_tokens: int | None,
    billing_model: str,
    status: str,
    notes: str | None,
) -> ServiceAgreement:
    agreement = ServiceAgreement(
        agreement_id=agreement_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        inquiry_id=inquiry_id,
        service_name=service_name,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
        billing_model=billing_model,
        status=status,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(agreement)
    db.flush()
    return agreement


def commit_agreement(db: Session, agreement: ServiceAgreement) -> ServiceAgreement:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(agreement)
    return agreement


def delete_agreement(db: Session, agreement: ServiceAgreement) -> None:
    db.delete(agreement)
    db.commit()

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Index, String, Text, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class ClientStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "Active"
    DORMANT = "Dormant"
    CHURNED = "Churned"


class Client(Base):
    __tablename__ = "clients"

    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    address: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    city: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    state: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    pincode: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=True)
    country: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=False, default="India")
    gst_number: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    primary_email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), nullable=False)
    primary_phone: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    # Wave 9 — official business-ID + Clients Sheet fields (additive)
    business_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    industry: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    date_onboarded: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    client_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False, default=ClientStatus.ACTIVE.value, server_default=ClientStatus.ACTIVE.value)
    first_lead_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    first_inquiry_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_clients_business_id", "business_id", unique=True),
        Index("ix_clients_industry", "industry"),
        Index("ix_clients_client_status", "client_status"),
        Index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "first_lead_id"),
        Index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "first_inquiry_id"),
    )

    feedbacks: Mapped[list["ClientFeedback"]] = relationship("ClientFeedback", back_populates="client", lazy="selectin")
    complaints: Mapped[list["ClientComplaint"]] = relationship("ClientComplaint", back_populates="client", lazy="selectin")

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    if status:
        query = query.filter(Client.client_status == status)

    if industry:
        query = query.filter(Client.industry == industry)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()

def create_client_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ClientCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Client:
    client = create_client(
        db,
        name=data.name,
        code=data.code,
        primary_email=data.primary_email,
        address=data.address,
        city=data.city,
        state=data.state,
        pincode=data.pincode,
        country=data.country,
        gst_number=data.gst_number,
        primary_phone=data.primary_phone,
        notes=data.notes,
        business_id=data.business_id,
        industry=data.industry,
        date_onboarded=data.date_onboarded,
        client_status=data.client_status,
        first_lead_id=data.first_lead_id,
        first_inquiry_id=data.first_inquiry_id,
    )

    if not client.business_id:
        client.business_id = next_business_id(db, "CLT", datetime.utcnow().year)

    create_entry(
        db,
        action="client.create",
        entity_type="client",
        entity_id=client.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        after_json={
            "id": str(client.id),
            "name": client.name,
            "code": client.code,
            "primary_email": client.primary_email,
            "business_id": client.business_id,
            "industry": client.industry,
            "client_status": client.client_status,
        },
    )

    return client

state.title: Debug schema create_all issue

parts.text:
Now I can see the problem clearly:

1. Before: 42 tables exist (from the previous tests or my manual DROP/CREATE didn't work)
2. After DROP/CREATE: 0 tables (the manual DROP/CREATE in my debug script worked)
3. First `create_all`: FAILS with `DuplicateTable: relation "audit_log" already exists`

So the issue is that even on a freshly created empty schema, the FIRST `create_all` fails with `audit_log` already existing!

This is really weird. The `pg_tables` shows 0 tables, but `create_all` says `audit_log` already exists.

This must mean that `audit_log` is somehow existing as a TYPE but not a TABLE, and PostgreSQL is complaining about creating a table with the same name as an existing type. In PostgreSQL, you can't create a table with the same name as an existing type in the same schema.

Let me check if `audit_log` exists as a type in `pg_type`:

input.command:
PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -c "
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

engine = create_engine('postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test')

with engine.connect() as conn:
    # Check if audit_log exists as a type
    result = conn.execute(text(\"SELECT oid, typname, typnamespace, typtype FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'audit_log'\"))
    for r in result:
        print(f'audit_log type: oid={r[0]}, schema={r[2]}, typtype={r[3]}')
    
    # What's the pg_namespace name for namespace 1174856?
    result = conn.execute(text(\"SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid = 1174856\"))
    for r in result:
        print(f'Namespace 1174856: {r[0]}')
    
    # List all composite types (typtype='c') that might conflict
    result = conn.execute(text(\"\"\"SELECT t.typname, n.nspname FROM pg_type t 
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON t.typnamespace = n.oid 
        WHERE t.typtype = 'c' AND n.nspname = 'public'\"\"\"))
    for r in result:
        print(f'Composite type in public: {r[1]}.{r[0]}')
    
    # List all types in public
    result = conn.execute(text(\"\"\"SELECT t.typname, t.typtype, n.nspname FROM pg_type t 
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON t.typnamespace = n.oid 
        WHERE n.nspname = 'public'\"\"\"))
    count = 0
    for r in result:
        count += 1
    print(f'Types in public: {count}')
" 2>&1

Actually, looking at the error more carefully: the `DuplicateTable` error from PostgreSQL is about the RELATION, not the TABLE. In PostgreSQL, tables, views, types, etc. all create entries in `pg_class`. A relation with the name `audit_log` already exists in the `public` schema. It could be a type (composite type) created by a previous table creation.

When SQLAlchemy's `create_all` creates a table, it:
1. Checks if the table exists in `information_schema.tables`
2. If not, executes `CREATE TABLE`

But PostgreSQL blocks creating a table if a TYPE with the same name exists in the same schema (because creating a table implicitly creates a composite type). So if a previous `audit_log` composite type exists (from a previously dropped table), PostgreSQL raises `DuplicateTable`.

The fix would be to also drop types in the `_reset_tables` function. Let me modify it:

Actually, the `DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE` should drop all tables AND their associated types. But maybe the issue is that `DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE` drops the table but not the implicit composite type? Let me check...

In PostgreSQL, when you `DROP TABLE`, its implicit composite type is also dropped. And `DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE` should cascade to all contained objects.

But wait, maybe the issue is different. Let me look at what my debug script showed:

1. `Before: 42 tables` - the DB already had 42 tables (from previous tests)
2. `After DROP/CREATE: 0 tables` - after dropping and recreating the schema, there are 0 tables
3. `First create_all` - FAILED

So the schema was emptied but `create_all` still fails. This is a clear indication that something besides a table exists with the name `audit_log`. It could be a type, a sequence, or another object.

In PostgreSQL, when a table is created, it also creates a composite type with the same name in `pg_type`. When the table is dropped (e.g., via `DROP TABLE ... CASCADE`), the composite type should also be dropped. But maybe `DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE` doesn't properly drop all composite types?

Actually, I think the issue might be related to the use of `INET` type. In some PostgreSQL versions, the `inet` type might require special handling.

import uuid

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.config import settings
from src.backend.core.security import (
    create_access_token,
    create_refresh_token,
    decode_token,
    verify_password,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.refresh_token_repo import create as create_refresh_token_record
from src.backend.db.repositories.refresh_token_repo import find_valid as find_valid_refresh_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.refresh_token_repo import revoke_all_for_user
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_email
from src.backend.schemas.auth import AccessTokenResponse, TokenResponse, UserPublic
from src.backend.services.audit_service import record_event


def login(
    db: Session,
    email: str,
    password: str,
    ip_address: str | None = None,
    user_agent: str | None = None,
) -> TokenResponse | None:
    user = get_by_email(db, email)
    if not user or not verify_password(password, user.password_hash):
        record_event(
            db, "auth.login_fail", user_id=None, ip_address=ip_address, user_agent=user_agent
        )
        return None

    access_token = create_access_token(user.id, user.role)
    refresh_token = create_refresh_token(user.id)

    create_refresh_token_record(db, user.id, refresh_token, settings.JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS)

    record_event(
        db, "auth.login_success", user_id=user.id, ip_address=ip_address, user_agent=user_agent
    )

    return TokenResponse(
        access_token=access_token,
        refresh_token=refresh_token,
        user=UserPublic.model_validate(user),
    )


def refresh_access_token(db: Session, refresh_token: str) -> AccessTokenResponse | None:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(refresh_token)
    except Exception:
        return None

    if payload.get("type") != "refresh":
        return None

    user_id = uuid.UUID(payload["sub"])
    valid_token = find_valid_refresh_token(db, refresh_token, user_id)
    if not valid_token:
        return None

    from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id

    user = get_by_id(db, user_id)
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        return None

    new_access_token = create_access_token(user.id, user.role)

    record_event(db, "auth.token_refresh", user_id=user.id)

    return AccessTokenResponse(access_token=new_access_token)


def logout(
    db: Session,
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    ip_address: str | None = None,
    user_agent: str | None = None,
) -> bool:
    revoke_all_for_user(db, user_id)
    record_event(db, "auth.logout", user_id=user_id, ip_address=ip_address, user_agent=user_agent)
    return True
